{{recipe}}

'''''Glace de viande''''' is a sauce made by reducing meat broth or stock until rich and condensed.

==Ingredients==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] brown [[Cookbook:Fond brun de boeuf|beef]] or [[Cookbook:Fond brun de veau|veal]] [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]], strained and thoroughly degreased

==Procedure==
#Pour the stock into a heavy non-reactive pot and bring it to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] over medium heat.
#Reduce the heat to low and let the stock cook until it has reduced to 2 cups, stirring from time to time.
#Transfer the stock to a small, non-reactive pan and heat over the lowest possible heat until it is reduced to ½ cup.
#Strain the glaze into a jar.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The meat glaze can be stored in the refrigerator for several months or frozen indefinitely. Thaw in the [[Cookbook:Microwave|microwave]] and mix before use.
